comment_regular: Native group dispatcher. Reads fixed group-table slot (+0x08) and note-template class (+0x0C), normalizing slot aliases 5->0 and 6->3. For note classes 0/1, playImmediately=0 stores only the encoded key at ActorAnimData +0x70[slot] and repeat/action value at +0x7C[slot]; playImmediately=1 clears that queue and plays now. Classes 2..7 play immediately. No queued sequence pointer or path is stored.
